about.hotkeys: Hotkeys can be rebound in the Hotkeys panel.
about.plugins: Loaded plugins are listed in the Plugins panel.
about.tagline: Dalamud-style mod framework for Blue Protocol: Star Resonance.
gameui.info: (i) Move or hide game HUD elements.
hotkeys.passthrough: Don't pass hotkeys through to the game
perf.perPlugin.desc: Override how often each plugin refreshes. Self-rate lets a plugin drive its own update rate: Boost speeds it up briefly (released after a 10 s safety cap); Self-managed lets the plugin fully control and hold its own rate with no cap. Default is Off (follows the global rate).
perf.rateDesc.default: Near-vanilla game FPS while keeping the HUD and input smooth enough that most players won't notice. The sweet spot.
perf.rateDesc.high: Smoother Stellar UI than the default, at some game-FPS cost — higher is smoother but more costly.
perf.rateDesc.low: Best game FPS — Stellar barely touches your frame rate. The HUD, cooldowns and on-screen info refresh only ~10-15×/sec, so they visibly lag and typing/dragging in Stellar feels delayed.
perf.rateDesc.max: Smoothest, most responsive Stellar UI — updates every rendered frame. Costs the most game FPS.
perf.uncap.desc: Removes the game's frame-rate cap (disables V-Sync + the FPS limit) so it runs as fast as your GPU allows. Higher FPS, but more GPU heat/power/fan noise and possible screen tearing.
perf.updateRate.desc: How often Stellar refreshes its HUD, input and overlays each second. Lower = more game FPS; higher = smoother Stellar UI.
themes.noCustom: No custom themes yet — clone a preset to start.
